title: Z80 REPL
summary: A browser-based interactive REPL environment for Z80 assembly language programming, allowing users to write, execute, and debug Z80 code directly in the web browser without any installation required.
problem_solved: Provides an accessible way to learn and experiment with classic 8-bit microprocessor programming without installing development tools.
why_valuable: Enables instant hands-on experience with Z80 assembly and retro computing concepts directly in the browser, lowering the barrier for enthusiasts and students.
